Two fixes:

1) Both bottom dotted containers have far too much bottom space. Reduce their bottom padding to ~30px so each container's bottom border sits just ~30px below its last box. Result: the LEFT container should end around y=955 (total height ~505px) and the RIGHT container around y=993 (total height ~545px), i.e. nothing extends past ~1000px on the page.

2) In the top dotted container, reduce the left group's left padding so box-1's left edge sits ~33px from the page's left edge, aligning with box-6 below.

Keep all labels box-1 … box-15 unchanged and visible.

Build an HTML wireframe, plain boxes with visible bordered outlines and the exact text label centered inside each. Page width ~1080px, padding 30px. Structure top to bottom:

1) A full-width dashed-border container (height ~170px) holding a left group and a right group on one row, vertically centered. Left group: box-1 (~115x55) then box-2 (~220x55), 25px gap, starting at left edge. Right group aligned to the right edge: box-3 (~115x55), box-4 (~115x55), box-5 (~115x55) with 8px gaps.

2) Below it, a row: box-6 on the left (~120px wide, 195px tall). To its right a column starting at x~168: box-7 (~300x62), then below it a row with box-8 (~120x58) and box-9 (~120x58) with 8px gap.

3) Below, two dashed-border containers side by side with a 20px gap: left one ~500px wide, right one ~505px wide, both with 18px inner padding. Left contains stacked boxes: box-10 (height 62), box-11 (height 195), box-12 (height 130). Right contains: box-13 (height 62), box-14 (height 235), box-15 (height 110). Right container sits ~15px lower is not needed; align tops.

One vertical fix inside container-1 only; keep all labels and everything else unchanged. The box-1 / box-2-3-4 row sits too high. Keep the 'container-1' label on its own line at the top-right, then increase the space between that label and the row to about 45px, and reduce the padding below the row to about 20px, so the row sits noticeably lower (roughly in the lower half of the container). Container-1's total height stays about 155px, and its top edge stays about 25px below the top of the page.

Both bottom dotted containers still extend too far down (their bottom borders run off past y=1000). Fix their bottom edges precisely: LEFT container's last box (box-12) should end at about y=935 and the container's dotted bottom border only ~20px below it, at about y=955 (total container height ~505px). RIGHT container: box-15 should end at about y=960 and its dotted bottom border ~33px below, at about y=993 (total height ~545px). Achieve this by reducing each container's bottom padding to ~20-30px, and if needed slightly increasing box-14 (~235px) and box-15 (~115px) heights so the right container's boxes fill down to y=960. Nothing on the page should extend below y=1000. Keep all labels box-1 … box-15 unchanged and visible.

Two refinements:

1) In both dashed containers, put the container label on its own line at the top-right, above the inner boxes, so it no longer overlaps them. Give each container ~12px inner padding. This makes container-1 about 155px tall total (label line + the 50px box row) and container-2 about 110px tall (label line + the 50px box row).

2) Add ~28px padding on the left and right edges of the whole page and ~28px at the top and bottom, so all boxes and containers are inset from the page edges rather than nearly touching them; keep the three-column and two-column widths proportional to the new content width.

Fix a few structural details: (a) box-10 should be ~415px wide but sit inside the left container starting at the same left inset as box-11 — keep it, it's fine; instead make the left container's contents inset ~15px and box-13 in the right container ~375px wide starting at the same left inset as box-14 (already OK). (b) Most importantly, the vertical spacing: reduce the gap between box-7 and the box-8/box-9 row so box-7's bottom edge is only ~8px above them, and make box-6 span the full height of that group (top aligned with box-7's top, bottom aligned with the bottom of box-8/box-9 plus a little, ~190px total). (c) Remove the 'container-1', 'container-2', 'container-3' label texts from the corners — instead the containers must still show a dashed border, but print no label text (the target shows no container labels). (d) Reduce the top container's height to ~150px and keep the row vertically centered.

Build an HTML wireframe page, full width, with plain bordered boxes each printing its exact label text inside, centered. Use a page container with about 30px padding. Structure top to bottom:

1) A dashed-border header container labeled 'container-1' (label printed in its top-right corner, small text). Inside it, a row: on the left a bordered box labeled 'box-1' about 220px wide and 50px tall; pushed to the far right, three bordered boxes labeled 'box-2', 'box-3', 'box-4' side by side, each about 115px, 90px, 115px wide and 50px tall with small gaps.

2) A row of three equal-width bordered boxes labeled 'box-5', 'box-6', 'box-7', each roughly one-third of the width with ~18px gaps, each about 250px tall, label centered vertically.

3) A two-column area below: the left column is about 23% wide, the right column fills the rest, with a gap between them.
   - Left column stacked vertically: 'box-8' (about 55px tall), then 'box-9' (about 225px tall), then 'box-10' (about 140px tall), with small vertical gaps.
   - Right column stacked vertically: 'box-11' (about 55px tall but only about half the column width, aligned left), then 'box-12' (full column width, about 95px tall), then 'box-13' (full column width, about 125px tall), with small vertical gaps.

4) A dashed-border footer container labeled 'container-2' (label printed in its top-right corner). Inside it, on the left, two small bordered boxes labeled 'box-14' and 'box-15' side by side, each about 115px wide and 50px tall.

Keep all labels visible as text inside their elements.

Build an HTML wireframe page (plain boxes with visible borders, each box printing its label text as centered content). Overall page width ~1080px with ~30px side margins.

1) Top header container (dotted border, full width, ~155px tall): inside it a left group with two boxes side by side — 'box-1' (~110px wide) and 'box-2' (~220px wide), both ~60px tall, vertically centered — and a right group aligned to the right edge with three boxes side by side: 'box-3' (~115px), 'box-4' (~120px), 'box-5' (~115px), all ~60px tall.

2) Below the header, a row: a tall box 'box-6' (~120px wide, ~195px tall) on the left; to its right a column containing 'box-7' (~300px wide, ~60px tall) on top, and below it a row of two boxes 'box-8' (~120px wide) and 'box-9' (~120px wide), each ~60px tall. This whole group only occupies the left half of the page; the right half is empty.

3) Below that, two dotted containers side by side, each ~48% of the page width, with a gap between them. Left container holds three stacked boxes, each nearly full container width: 'box-10' (~65px tall), 'box-11' (~195px tall), 'box-12' (~130px tall). Right container holds three stacked boxes: 'box-13' (~65px tall), 'box-14' (~240px tall), 'box-15' (~110px tall). The right container is slightly taller and shifted down slightly at the bottom compared to the left one.

Inside the two lower dotted containers, make the first box of each column narrower than the ones below it: 'box-10' should be about 80% of the container's inner width (left-aligned, so its right edge stops noticeably short of 'box-11'/'box-12' right edges), and likewise 'box-13' should be about 78% of its container's inner width, left-aligned, stopping short of 'box-14'/'box-15' right edges. Keep box-11, box-12, box-14, box-15 at full inner width as they are.

Vertical spacing polish: add ~30px padding at the top of the page (so the dotted header container starts ~30px down instead of at the very top edge), make the header container ~175px tall, add ~30px vertical gap between the header container and the 'box-6'/'box-7'/'box-8'/'box-9' row, and ~25px gap between that row and the two lower dotted containers. Keep all widths and labels unchanged.

Adjust the alignment and sizing in the middle section: decrease the width of the left column (containing box-8, box-9, and box-10) to about 25% of the page width. Ensure box-11, box-12, and box-13 in the right column are left-aligned and do not stretch to the full width of their container, particularly box-11 which should be shorter. Increase the vertical spacing between the row containing boxes 5, 6, 7 and the row below it.

Adjust the column widths and element sizes: the left column containing box-2 through box-7 should be much narrower. In the middle column, box-9 should be wider than box-8. In the right column, box-11 should be taller and box-10, box-12, and box-13 should be narrower. Ensure box-1 is left-aligned above the left and middle columns.

Below the navigation bar, create a layout section. On the left, add a vertical box labeled box-6. To the right of box-6, add a column containing box-7 at the top, and a row underneath it containing box-8 and box-9 side-by-side.

Adjust the horizontal layout: move box-8 and box-9 significantly further to the right, closer to box-10 and box-11. Make box-9 wider, so its right edge ends roughly halfway across the total page width. In the right column, make box-11 much taller, extending its bottom edge well below the bottom edge of box-9. Ensure box-10 and box-11 are left-aligned and have equal width. Move box-12 and box-13 further down and to the right so they are right-aligned with the right edge of box-11, with box-13 being slightly narrower than box-12.

Adjust the middle section's layout: box-11, box-12, and box-13 should span the full width of their column, making them much wider than boxes 8, 9, and 10. Also, ensure box-11, box-12, and box-13 are stacked vertically, with box-11 at the top, followed by box-12, and then box-13.

Adjust the layout to match the target: box-1 should not span the full width, it should be a smaller box at the top left. The three columns should have significant spacing between them. Make boxes 2 through 7 much smaller and left-aligned. Box-9 should be wider than it is tall, and box-11 should be taller than box-9. Align box-8 above the start of box-9, and box-10 above the start of box-11. Ensure there is large vertical whitespace between the (box-2,3,4) group and the (box-5,6,7) group, and also between box-11 and box-12.
